title: Prove you are human
observation: A familiar task: inspect an image and select the matching squares.
question: Select all squares containing any part of the cat.
reveal: You just annotated an image. Each submitted grid creates nine binary labels: cat selected / cat not selected. Human annotations can be used to train or evaluate computer vision models; agreement between annotators can help assess label quality. Border tiles show why instructions and human judgment matter. This classroom CAPTCHA is a simulation: no model is trained and no labels are sent to an external training service. These percentages show human selections, not model confidence or a verified answer key. Discuss: who supplies the labor, who benefits, and did the person clicking understand the purpose?

title: Where do you invest?
observation:
As Surveillance & Privacy Co. LTD E052, you are trying to make an investment on which sector of surveillance to focus on.

Your customers already have cameras. They want better security, fewer missed incidents, and less time spent watching screens.

You have one development budget.
question: Where do you invest?
options:
Better cameras
Invest in the development of high-end video cameras that integrate Intel AI and Ryzen AI chips that offer computational power to support real-time AI analysis, and advanced features like live tracing without human intervention.

Smarter software
Invest in acquiring high-quality video datasets and developing AI models that turn existing camera feeds into real-time insights through object detection, activity tracking, and automated alerts, without requiring customers to replace their cameras.

Surveillance as a service
Pivot early and compete with Amazon and other cloud computing service providers by focusing on remote access and storage of collected video information.

title: Where should we sell?
observation: Surveillance & Privacy Co. LTD E052 is mainly interested in government contracts. We need to pitch our software and hardware idea to countries based on their likelihood of integrating our software and how much money each government is willing to put into installing our systems.
question: Where should we sell?
options:
Closed autocracies
Examples: China, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates.

Electoral autocracies / competitive autocracies
Examples: Russia, Turkey, and Egypt.

Electoral democracies / illiberal democracies
Examples: India, Brazil, and the Philippines.

Advanced democracies
Examples: the United States, Germany, and Canada.
